Definition: a Chebrite (collectively) or descendants of Cheber
BiblicalUsage: The Heberites are the family of Heber the son of Beriah, counted in the second census of Israel in the wilderness. The clan takes its name from its father, and the name is the record of the family.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts families in the wilderness as carefully as He counts tribes, and the Heberites are named because they belong.
